message: The project has no place for these parts of info, so they aren't kept: summary and license
OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect schemes are bearer token schemes in the app; their flows, URLs, and scopes are in each one's description: oidc
These security schemes have no counterpart in the app, so they were left out, and the operations that need only them are public in the project: mtls (mutualTLS)
Scopes aren't kept (1 requirement, like oidc: events:read)
Extensions aren't kept (2 places: x-rate-limit and x-tagGroups)
1 parameter or header described by a media type keeps only its schema: filter (GET /events/{eventId}/tickets)
The app records one scheme per alternative, so 1 requirement for several schemes together records only the first it has: apiKey and basic → apiKey
A body has one media type in the app, so 1 other one was left out: text/csv (GET /reports 200)
Authentication is optional in 1 place (/paths/~1public~1feed/get/security); the project records it as required
1 example was left out, since the app keeps example values: from-file (GET /public/feed 200: its value is in another file, which the app never reads)
Shared examples were copied into each response that uses them (1 example: conference)
